facts.fact: GatherUp's Local Businesses plan is listed at $99 per month for one location, billed annually.
GatherUp's Multiple Locations plan is listed at $60 per month per location, billed annually with price per location.
GatherUp's Agency plan is listed with custom pricing rather than a published price.
GatherUp states that annual billing saves about 20% compared with month-to-month billing.
GatherUp states that all prices on the pricing page are shown in US dollars.
GatherUp states that month-to-month plans carry no annual commitment, while annual plans can be paid upfront or monthly.
facts.quote: Annual plans can be paid upfront or monthly; month-to-month plans have no annual commitment.

facts.fact: GatherUp states that multi-location rates vary by location count and billing period.
facts.quote: Multi-location rates vary by location count and billing period.

facts.fact: GatherUp states that Listings Management and Review Defense are separate options that are not included in the base plans.
facts.quote: Listings Management and Review Defense are separate options.

facts.fact: GatherUp's Review Defense Reveal plan, which provides insights into review authenticity, is listed at $45 per month per location, billed annually.
facts.quote: Insights into the authenticity of your reviews

facts.fact: GatherUp states that Review Defense plans require an annual commitment with either payment option.
GatherUp positions its Agency plan as white-label reputation management for agencies serving local businesses, with custom pricing.
facts.quote: White-label options for agencies serving local businesses.
